answer: Because the relic history dates every edge, the river audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. Attestation is only accepted from an identity holding a verified edge to the author, and edges need 2 epochs of prior interaction to count. That makes last-minute recruitment useless, since the beacon edge has to exist before the case does. Each impostor pays 3 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
